p0.original: 关键问题：婴儿拥有哪些先天能力
p0.en: Key issue: What is the congenital ability of the baby?

p2.original: 新生儿具有某些先天的能力，这些能力可以帮助他们找到营养物质、回避危险情境，以及与他人互动——所有这些能力都有助于他们生存下去。
p2.en: Newborn children have certain congenital abilities that help them find nutrients, avoid dangerous situations and interact with others — all of which help them survive.

p3.original: 过去人们认为，婴儿就是一张白纸——脑袋空空，什么也不会。然而，如今人们的观念已经发生了变化。我们了解到新生儿通过他们的基因获得了一系列令人赞叹的能力。他们擅长发现食物和避免可能的伤害，他们的社交天性也有利于他们的生存。在核心概念中，我们将关注这些固有的或者先天的能力。核心概念指出：
p3.en: In the past, babies were thought to be a piece of paper — empty head, nothing. However, attitudes have changed today. We have learned that newborns have acquired an impressive range of capabilities through their genes. They are good at discovering food and avoiding possible harm, and their social instincts are beneficial to their survival. In the core concept, we will focus on those inherent or congenital capabilities. The core concept states that:

p4.original: 新生儿具有某些先天的能力，这些能力可以帮助他们找到营养物质、回避危险情境，以及与他人互动——所有这些能力都有助于他们生存下去。
p4.en: Newborn children have certain congenital abilities that help them find nutrients, avoid dangerous situations and interact with others — all of which help them survive.

p5.original: 确实，新生儿的能力是有限的，但是这些能力已经足以帮助他们生存。你来到的是一个你“了解过”的世界。例如，如何通过吸吮获得营养物质，如何抬手挡住眼睛来避免强光，如何通过喔啊声和哭泣来获得关注。但是，我们仍将新生儿的这些基本能力视为一种“脚手架”，随着他们的成长，在“脚手架”上他们将搭建新的、更为复杂的能力。
p5.en: It is true that newborns have limited capacities, but they are already sufficient to help them survive. You're coming to a world you've known. For example, how to obtain nutrients by sucking, how to hold hands to avoid strong light, and how to get attention through ow-ah-ah and crying. However, we still see these basic abilities of newborns as a “scaffolding” on which they will build new, more complex capabilities as they grow up.

p6.original: 为了解释这些能力来自哪里以及它们是如何发展的，我们将围绕以下三个重要发展阶段来展开讨论：胎儿期、新生儿期和婴儿期。你将会注意到，每一个阶段的发展都以早期的能力为基础，并且立足于早期的结构。
p6.en: In order to explain where and how these capabilities come from, we will discuss three important stages of development: foetal, neonatal and infant life. You will note that each stage of development is based on early capacity and early structure.

p8.en: 7.1 Describe the stages of foetal development.

p9.original: 7.2 解释出生时具有的反射反应和能力是如何有效地帮助新生儿生存和成长的。
p9.en: 7.2 Explain how the reflexes and abilities at birth are effective in helping newborns to survive and grow.

p10.original: 7.3 讨论先天因素和后天因素是如何交互影响婴儿的发展的。
p10.en: 7.3 Discuss how congenital and congenital factors interact to influence the development of infants.

p13.original: 描述胎儿期发育的各个阶段。
p13.en: Describe the stages of foetal development.

p14.original: 胎儿期（prenatal period）是指从受孕到出生之间的这段飞速发展时期，它使有机体做好了在子宫外独立生存的准备。这个时间通常是9个月，可以分成三个阶段：受精卵、胚胎和胎儿阶段。
p14.en: Prenatal period is the period of rapid development between conception and birth, which prepares organisms to survive independently outside the uterus. This period is usually nine months and can be divided into three stages: fertilized eggs, embryos and fetuses.

p15.en: 7.1.1 Three stages of the foetal period

p16.original: 1. 受精卵阶段：受孕后不久，受精卵，也称为合子（zygote），就开始细胞分裂。在受精卵阶段，细胞从一个分裂为两个，两个分裂为四个；在受孕一周左右，它的细胞数量达到150个左右时，合子便会把自己植入子宫内膜。从此时开始，它（连同胎盘细胞和其他支持细胞）成为胚胎（embryo）。它与母体连在一起，因此也会受到母亲饮食和接触的一切东西的影响。
p16.en: 1. fertilized eggs: soon after conception, the fertilized eggs, also known as zygote, begin to split. During the fertilisation stage, cells split from one to two and two to four; In the week of conception, the number of cells reached around 150, the hysteresis implanted itself into the uterus. From that point on, it (with placental and other support cells) became embryo (embryo). It is linked to the parent and is therefore also influenced by the mother's diet and exposure to everything.

p17.original: 2. 胚胎阶段：在胚胎阶段，遗传规划决定了新生儿所有的组织器官是如何开始形成的。在分化过程中，胚胎的细胞开始分化成为特定器官的组成部分。（在分化之前，胚胎中的某些细胞，也就是胚胎干细胞，可以生成身体的任何器官。）生理性别的发展就是分化的一个例子：如果胚胎的遗传规划包含两个X染色体，那么她将会是女孩；如果它包含一个X染色体和一个Y染色体，那么他将会是男孩。
p17.en: 2. The embryo stage: During the embryo stage, genetic planning determines how all the tissues of the newborn child begin to be formed. In the process of separation, embryonic cells began to divide into parts of particular organs. (Before it is divided, certain cells in the embryo, namely embryonic stem cells, can produce any organ of the body. The development of the biological sex is an example of the division: if the genetic planning of the embryo consists of two X chromosomes, she will be a girl; If it contains an X chromosome and an Y chromosome, he'll be a boy.

p18.original: 随着胚胎的发育，大脑快速生长，它每分钟能生成多达250 000个神经元！
p18.en: As the embryo develops, the brain grows fast, producing as many as 250,000 neurons per minute!

p19.original: 3. 胎儿阶段：大约8周之后，胚胎就发育为胎儿（fetus）。在胎儿阶段，自发运动和基本反射开始出现。例如，大约14周时，通过超声波就会看到一些胎儿会在有东西碰到他们的手掌时弯曲他们的手（Sparling et al.，et al.1999）。这是抓握反射的开端，它具有适应性（adaptive）意义。（想一想：为什么自动抓住碰到他的物体会有助于婴儿的生存？）到胎儿16周时，大脑已经形成，胎儿开始能够感觉到痛（Anand & Hickey，1987）。27周时，胎儿可以听见子宫外的声音，这为他们出生后能够区分某些声音和旋律打下了基础。大脑继续发育，以高达250000个/分钟的惊人速度生成新的神经元。最终，在出生时，新生儿的大脑大约已经具有1000亿个神经元（Dowling，1992）。
p19.en: 3. Foetal stage: After approximately eight weeks, embryos develop into fetus (fetus). At the foetal stage, spontaneous movements and basic reflections begin to emerge. For example, in about 14 weeks, ultrasound shows that some fetuses bend their hands when something touches their palms (Sparling et al., et al. 1999). It's the beginning of a grip on reflection, and it's adaptive. (Think about it: Why would it help the baby to survive if it automatically caught something that touched him? By 16 weeks, the brain had formed and the foetus began to feel pain (Anand & Hickey, 1987). Twenty-seven weeks, the foetus can hear the voice outside the womb, which provides the basis for the difference between certain voices and melody after birth. The brain continues to develop, generating new neurons at an alarming rate of up to 250,000 minutes. Finally, at birth, the newborn has about 100 billion neurons in his brain (Dowling, 1992).

p21.original: 在胎儿发育阶段，胎盘（placenta）是胚胎/胎儿周围的组织。它就像一根导管连接母亲和胎儿，可以让营养物质传送给胎儿并排出废弃物，也能够屏蔽一些（但不是所有）有害物质。某些有害物质仍然能够传送给胎儿，并造成不可修复的损伤，这些物质被称为致畸物（teratogen）。致畸物包括病毒（如HIV——艾滋病毒）、某些药物和化学物质，以及一些草药。最常见的致畸物是尼古丁和酒精。
p21.en: At the stage of fetal development, placental (placenta) is the tissue around the embryo/foetal. It is like a catheter that connects the mother and the foetus, allows nutrients to be passed to the foetus and discharges the waste, and can shield some (but not all) harmful substances. Certain harmful substances, known as teratogens, can still be transmitted to the foetus and cause irreparable damage. The teratogenics include viruses (e.g. HIV-HIV), certain drugs and chemical substances, and some herbs. The most common teratogenics are nicotine and alcohol.

p22.original: 怀孕时喝酒可能会导致胎儿酒精综合征（fetal alcohol syndrome，FAS）。FAS主要会造成儿童智力低下，影响儿童的运动协调能力，注意力受损和多动。母亲每天喝一杯或更多的酒就有可能使胎儿有酒精暴露的风险，研究人员已发现这会损害语言能力、记忆、学习和其他一系列的认知和生理机能（Office of the Surgeon General，2005）。此外，美国匹兹堡大学（University of Pittsburgh）的系列研究表明，即使是非常小的酒精暴露（每周少于5杯）也会导致胎儿出生后智力低下以及明显的身体发育迟缓：在14岁时，曾经在子宫接触过少量酒精的儿童比那些母亲在怀孕时从不饮酒的儿童平均要轻16磅（大约7.2千克）（Day，2002；Willford，2006）。我们要谨记，在怀孕的任何阶段都没有一个酒精安全剂量（Centers for Disease Control and Prevention，2015）。通过胎盘，胎儿会像母亲一样吸收酒精，但是他们却没有功能正常的肝脏或者其他器官来代谢酒精。在大脑和身体飞速发育的关键时期，任何微小剂量的酒精都会构成风险。
p22.en: Drinking alcohol during pregnancy may lead to fetal alcohol syndrome (fetal alcohol syndrome, FAS). The FAS can mainly result in children's mental deficiencies, affect their ability to coordinate their movements, and suffer from impaired and volatile attention. A mother's daily drink or more carries the risk of alcohol exposure to the foetus, which researchers have found to be damaging to language abilities, memory, learning and a range of other cognitive and physiological functions (Office of the Surgeon General, 2005). In addition, a series of studies at the University of Pittsburgh (United of Pittsburg) in the United States has shown that even very small alcohol exposure (less than 5 cups per week) can lead to post-natal mental retardation and apparent physical retardation: at age 14, children who had had little alcohol contact in the womb were on average 16 pounds less (approximately 7.2 kg) than those whose mothers never drank at the time of pregnancy (Day, 2002); Willford, 2006. We must remember that there is no alcohol safe dose at any stage of pregnancy (Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, 2015). The fetuses absorb alcohol like the mother through the placenta, but they do not have functioning livers or other organs to metabolize alcohol. Any small dose of alcohol poses a risk during critical periods of rapid brain and body development.

p23.original: 尼古丁也会伤害到发育中的胎儿。母亲在孕期抽烟可能会导致新生儿在出生时体重过低，罹患学习障碍和多动症（Button et al.，2005）。产妇抽烟也会加大婴儿患猝死综合征（sudden infant death syndrome，SIDS）的风险（Bruin et al.，2007）。有研究发现，甚至一些常见的草药和膳食补充剂也会影响胎儿发育，如银杏和高丽参（Chan et al.，2003；Dugoua et al.，2006）。
p23.en: Nicotine can also harm the developing foetus. Smoking during pregnancy may lead to low birth weight and learning disorders and hyperactivity in newborns (Button et al., 2005). Tobacco use by mothers also increases the risk of sudden death syndrome (sudden infant death syndrome, SIDS) for infants (Bruin et al., 2007). Studies have found that even some common herbs and dietary supplements can affect foetal development, such as almonds and currysing (Chan et al., 2003); Dugoua et al., 2006).

p24.original: 7.2 新生儿期：新生儿的能力
p24.en: 7.2 Neonatal period: capacity of the newborn

p26.original: 解释出生时具有的反射反应和能力是如何有效地帮助新生儿生存和成长的。
p26.en: Explain how the reflexes and abilities at birth have been effective in helping newborns to survive and grow.

p27.original: 在新生儿降临这个世界的时候，他们的很多神经和感觉系统已发育完成。新生儿期（neonatal period）指的是出生后的第一个月。当前我们对新生儿感觉觉知的理解已经与过去专家认为和形容的“喧嚣繁芜，杂乱无章”相去甚远（James，1890/1950）。实际上，近期的研究认为，新生儿具有全部五种感觉，并且他们会用各种行为反射来对外部环境进行反应和操纵。总之，这些能力能够有效地帮助新生儿在其环境中生存和成长。
p27.en: Many of their nervous and sensory systems were fully developed by the time the newborns arrived in the world. Neonatal period (neonatal period) refers to the first month after birth. Our current understanding of the perception of newborns is far from what past experts have seen and described as “a gruesome and unbridled noise” (James, 1890/1950). In fact, recent studies have concluded that newborns have all five feelings and that they react and manipulate the external environment with a variety of behavioural reflections. In short, these capabilities can effectively help newborns to survive and grow in their environment.

p29.original: 在出生的时候，婴儿就具有一系列引人注目的先天反射（innate reflex），这些反射为后续的发展提供了生物基础。姿势反射（postural reflex）让婴儿可以在有支撑的时候坐着。抓握反射（grasping reflex）让婴儿可以抓住照料者。觅食反射（rooting reflex）是指当有东西（乳头或者手指）接触婴儿的一边脸颊时，他们会把头转向那个方向，并且开始吸吮。你可能也曾注意到，如果你让婴儿直立在一个固体表面上，他的腿就会抬起来并开始迈步，这就是踏步反射（stepping reflex），这会帮助婴儿为将来走路做准备。还有一些反射仿佛是身体的嵌入式安全程序，可以帮助婴儿回避大的噪声、强光和疼痛刺激。他们的咿呀声、笑声和哭声是他们建立社交关系的最有效的工具。当然，所有这些都具有进化意义，因为这些能力具有高度的适应性并且可以促进个体生存。
p29.en: At birth, babies have a series of dramatic innate reflections (innate reflix), which provide the biological basis for subsequent development. Postural reflex allows babies to sit when they have support. Grasping reflection allows the baby to catch the caregiver. Retroactive feeding means that when something touches the cheek of a baby, they turn their head in that direction and start sucking. You may have noticed that if you keep the baby on a solid surface, his legs will be lifted up and he will start to walk, which is stepping reflection, which will help the baby to prepare for walking in the future. There are also reflections as if they were embedded safety procedures in the body that help the baby avoid the great noise, strong light and pain. Their laughter, laughter and crying are the most effective tools for social networking. Of course, all of this is evolutionary, as these capabilities are highly adaptable and promote individual survival.

p31.original: 新生儿拥有的感觉能力是如何帮助他们更好地生存的？一方面，他们能对味道做出反应：液体越甜，婴儿吸吮的时间越长，力量也越大（Lipsitt et al.，1976）。另一方面，当闻到香蕉的气味时，他们会笑起来，并且他们喜欢加了盐的麦片粥而不是淡的（Bernstein，1990；Harris et al.，1990）。但是，当他们尝到柠檬或虾的味道，或者闻到臭鸡蛋的气味时，他们会往后缩。而且，早在出生后12小时，他们就会对糖水或香草的味道表露出愉快的迹象。所有这些反应都是新生儿所具有的用于寻找营养物质的先天能力的一部分——正如本阶段的核心概念所介绍的。
p31.en: How can the sensory abilities of newborns help them to survive better? On the one hand, they are able to react to the taste: the sweeter the liquid, the longer the baby sucks, the more powerful it is (Lipsitt et al., 1976). On the other hand, when they smell bananas, they laugh, and they like salted cereal, not light (Bernstein, 1990); Harris et al., 1990. But when they taste lemons or shrimps, or smell stinking eggs, they shrink. Moreover, 12 hours after birth, they show happy signs of taste of sugar or vanilla. All of these responses are part of the birthable ability of newborns to search for nutrients — as described in the core concept at this stage.

p32.original: 正如遗传会影响新生儿的味觉一样，遗传也决定了新生儿偏好人类面孔而不是绝大多数其他视觉模式（Fantz，1963）。甚至新生儿的近视特点也有助于这种偏好：他们的最佳视觉焦点是30厘米，非常适宜观看面孔。新生儿在出生之后只需要几天时间就能认出母亲的面孔。然而他们的远距离视力非常差，视敏度大约是20/500（这意味着大多数较大的孩子可以在152米之外辨别的刺激，需要放到6米远的地方新生儿才能辨别）。然而，这些不成熟的系统成长得非常快（Banks & Bennett，1988），大约7周时，婴儿的视觉通路和运动协调系统就能使他们保持与照料者之间的眼神接触——这是建立人际关系的最重要的元素。
p32.en: Just as genetic influences the taste of newborns, genetics also determines the preference of newborns for human faces rather than for most other visual patterns (Fantz, 1963). Even the near-sighted characteristics of newborns contribute to this preference: their best visual focus is 30 centimetres, which are very appropriate for looking at faces. It takes only a few days after birth for the newborn to recognize her mother's face. However, their long-range vision is very poor and their sensitivity is about 20/500 (which means that most older children can identify stimulations from 152 metres away and need to be placed 6 metres away in order for newborns to be identified). However, these immature systems have grown very quickly (Banks & Bennett, 1988), and in about seven weeks the baby's visual access and motor coordination system will enable them to maintain eye contact with the caregiver — the most important element in building human relationships.

p33.original: 新生儿还具有哪些感觉能力呢？虽然新生儿可以看到颜色，但是他们区分颜色的能力（如区分红色和橙色、红色和蓝色的能力）要到出生后1～2个月才得以迅速发展（Teller，1998）。他们还偏好高对比度的物体，如国际象棋的棋盘、飞镖盘。3个月大的时候，婴儿可以感知到深度，并且他们的视觉能力已经接近成年人。
p33.en: What are the sensory abilities of newborns? Although the colour is visible to newborns, their ability to distinguish colours (e.g. the ability to distinguish between red and orange, red and blue) does not develop rapidly until one to two months after birth (Teller, 1998). They also prefer objects with high contrasts, such as chess boards and darts. At the age of three months, babies can feel depth and their visual abilities are close to adults.

p34.original: 此外，你可能想不到，婴儿具有对数量的基本觉知。一项非常巧妙的研究让婴儿观看玩具娃娃被放到一个展示柜中或者被从展示柜中拿出去。当展示柜中娃娃的数量发生变化时，婴儿注视柜子的时间会变长，这表明他们对意料之外的结果表现出了更大的兴趣——好像他们正在努力找出哪里出了问题（Wynn，1992，1995）。
p34.en: Besides, you probably didn't think that babies had a basic sense of quantity. A very clever study has allowed babies to watch dolls in a display cabinet or to be taken out of the display cabinet. When the number of dolls in the display cabinet changes, the baby's time to look at the cabinet becomes longer, indicating a greater interest in unexpected results - as if they were trying to find out what was wrong (Wynn, 1992, 1995).

p35.original: 进一步的研究证实了婴儿这种对数量的直觉。例如，研究发现6个月大的婴儿可以区分有10个点的屏幕和有20个点的屏幕（Starr et al.，2013）。而且，那些在6个月时直观数感最好的孩子在3岁时的基本数学测试（例如，“约翰尼有1块饼干，妈妈又给了他3块，现在约翰尼有几块饼干？”）成绩也更好。因此，这种基本的数量觉知似乎是天生的，并且是随后发展更复杂技能（如算术能力）的基础（Spelke，2000）。灵长类和有些种系的动物也具有婴儿的这种对数量的直觉，这在进化上是说得通的——毕竟，判断掠食者是否超过自己种群的数量会很有用。
p35.en: Further research confirms this intuitiveness of the number of infants. For example, it was found that infants aged six months could distinguish between 10 dots and 20 dots (Starr et al., 2013). Besides, the best-looking kids in six months have a basic math test at the age of three. I'm not sure I'm going to be able to do that. Thus, this basic quantitative perception appears to be natural and to be the basis for the subsequent development of more complex skills, such as numeracy (Spelke, 2000). Prims and some species also have this intuitive perception of the number of babies, which is evolutionaryally relevant — after all, it would be useful to judge whether predators are larger than their populations.

p36.original: 婴儿观看快速变化的两张插片：右侧插片上一直是10个点，左侧插片上点的数量在10到20之间变化。那些能够觉察到不同（对变化的点观看时间更长）的婴儿，在3岁时的数学测验成绩更好。
p36.en: Babies watch two fast-changing plugins: the number of points above the right plugin has been 10, and the number of points above the left plugin has changed between 10 and 20. Those babies who can detect different (longer watch times for changing points) have better results in math tests at the age of 3.

p37.original: 新生儿还具有明显的声音偏好，更喜欢人声而不是其他声音，更喜欢母语的声音和节奏而不是非母语的（Goodwyn & Acredolo，2000）。在认定这些偏好是遗传的之前，我们应该想到，在孕晚期，发育中的胎儿在母亲子宫中是可以听见外界的声音的。因此，另一个可能的解释是，婴儿的这种声音偏好源于他们曾经接触过母语的声音。为了考察这种偏好是源自遗传因素还是环境因素，有一项研究让准妈妈在怀孕的最后6周每天朗读两次《戴帽子的猫》（The Cat in the Hat）；然后，在婴儿出生后，研究人员给他们播放妈妈读这个故事和读其他故事的录音。这项研究发现了什么呢？婴儿对熟悉的故事的声音偏好完全超过了陌生故事。新生儿还表现出对女性声音的偏好，并且在出生之后的几周内，他们就能够辨认出妈妈的声音了（Carpenter，1973；DeCasper & Spence，1986）。因此，后天因素（即先前经验）可能是新生儿声音偏好的驱动力。
p37.en: Newborn children also have a clear preference for voices, preferring humans over others, and preferring the voice and rhythm of their mother tongue rather than non-mother tongue (Goodwyn & Acredolo, 2000). Before considering that these preferences are inherited, we should be reminded that, in the late stages of pregnancy, the developing foetus can hear the outside voice in the mother's womb. Thus, another possible explanation is that this voice preference of infants stems from the voice of their mother tongue. In order to examine whether this preference is derived from genetic or environmental factors, a study has made the mother-to-be read The Cat in the Hat twice a day during the last six weeks of pregnancy; Then, after the baby was born, researchers gave it to their mothers to read the story and to read other stories. What did the study find? The voice of the baby over the familiar story is far more than that of a stranger. Newborn children also show a preference for women's voices, and within weeks of birth they can recognize their mothers ' voices (Carpenter, 1973); DeCasper & Spencer, 1986. Therefore, the after-day factor (i.e., previous experience) may be the driving force behind the preference for the voice of the newborn.

p39.original: 你是否曾经注意到，如果你对着婴儿吐舌头，他也会向你吐舌头（Meltzoff & Moore，1983，1989）。这个有趣的游戏仅仅展示了新生儿和婴儿能够模仿的众多行为的一种。过去，一些儿童发展专家认为，这可能反映了婴儿对他人行为的深层认知，但最近镜像神经元（mirror neuron）的发现提供了另一种可能性更高的解释。对各种行为的模仿（mimicry），像我们讨论过的其他先天能力一样，能帮助婴儿在环境中更好地生存和成长。
p39.en: Have you ever noticed that if you spit on the baby, he will spit on you (Meltzoff & Moore, 1983, 1989). This interesting game is just one of many behaviours that newborns and babies can imitate. In the past, some child development experts have argued that this may reflect the deeper perception of the behaviour of others, but the recent discovery of mirror neurons provides another more likely explanation. Mimicry, like other congenital abilities that we have discussed, helps infants to survive and grow better in the environment.

p40.original: 正如先前讨论所表明的那样，婴儿是为社交活动而生的。事实上，从出生那一刻起，他们不只是对照料者有反应，而且还能够与照料者互动。对这类互动录像的研究揭示了一种令人惊异的同步性（synchronicity，Martin，1981）。当婴儿回应和学习时，他们也会向那些愿意倾听并且爱他们的人发出自己的信息。一些研究展示了这种互动的结果：母亲和婴儿的表情表现出一致性（Fogel，1991）。因此，3个月大的婴儿会在妈妈笑的时候笑起来，也会用皱眉或哭泣来回应妈妈的负面表情（Tronick et al.，1980）。这些早期的互动，是先天（镜像神经元）和后天（从模仿中获得的积极强化）共同作用的结果，它们为儿童后期共情能力的发展奠定了基础。
p40.en: As previous discussions had shown, babies were born for social purposes. In fact, from the moment of birth, they are not only responsive to caregivers, but also able to interact with them. A study of such interactive videos reveals an amazing synchronization (synchronicity, Martin, 1981). When babies respond and learn, they also send their message to those who are willing to listen and love them. Some studies show the results of this interaction: the expression of mother and baby is consistent (Fogel, 1991). As a result, three-month-old babies laugh when their mother smiles and respond to their mother's negative expression with frown or weeping (Tronick et al., 1980). These early interactions are the result of a combination of congenital (simulation neurons) and acquired (a positive reinforcement from imitation), which lay the foundation for the development of the child's capacity for later mutuality.

p41.original: 7.3 婴儿期：以新生儿期为基础
p41.en: 7.3 Infant period: based on neonatal period

p43.original: 讨论先天因素和后天因素是如何交互影响婴儿的发展的。
p43.en: Discussion of how congenital and acquired factors interact to influence the development of infants.

p44.original: 婴儿期（infancy）在新生儿期之后，一直持续到出生后的18个月——这个时期语言开始得到较好的发展（拉丁词根infans的含义就是“不能说话”）。这是一个按遗传程序快速成长的时期，也是仍然严重依赖于我们前面讨论过的反射和“本能”行为的时期。所有这些能力都来自一个神经系统，该系统正以惊人的速度发展。
p44.en: Infanthood continues after the neonatal period, up to 18 months after birth - a period in which the language has begun to develop better (the Latin word infans means “no talking”). This is a period of rapid genetic growth and still heavily dependent on reflection and “in instinct” behaviour, which we discussed earlier. All of these capabilities come from a nervous system that is developing at an alarming rate.

p46.original: 胎儿大脑的主要任务是生成新的脑细胞，但出生时很多细胞还没有相互充分连接。为了生成和巩固连接，来自环境的刺激会起到至关重要的作用。每当婴儿接触一个新刺激，树突和轴突就开始生长和分叉，从而促使与这次经历有关的神经元之间的连接生成（Kolb，1989）。新生成的神经元之间的连接使用的频率越高，它们就越可能变成永久连接。换句话说：“那些同时放电的神经元会连接起来”（Courchesne et al.，1994）。
p46.en: The main task of the foetus's brain is to generate new brain cells, but many of them were not fully connected at birth. Incentives from the environment can play a crucial role in generating and consolidating connectivity. Whenever a baby is exposed to a new irritation, the tree and axles begin to grow and split fork, thus contributing to the generation of connections between neurons associated with the experience (Kolb, 1989). The higher the frequency of connection between newly generated neurons, the more likely they are to become permanent. In other words, “the neurons that are simultaneously discharged are connected” (Courchesne et al., 1994).

p47.original: 随着树突和轴突的生长与连接，大脑中神经组织的总质量迅速增加——2岁时增加了50%，到4岁时几乎翻了一番。在接下来的10年中，儿童接触的经验类型在很大程度上决定了其大脑的哪些区域和哪些功能会发展得最好。婴儿或儿童的某项特定经验越多——可能是阅读、运动、音乐、划独木舟、园艺或钓鱼，与这个活动有关的脑区就会变得越强，密度越高。如你所推测的那样，这是一个适应过程——花在这些活动上的时间越多，大脑和身体在这些领域的准备就越充分，从而为个体在特定环境中获得成功做好准备。
p47.en: With the growth and connection of tree and axle twitches, the total mass of neurons in the brain has increased rapidly — 50 per cent at age 2, almost doubling by age 4. Over the next 10 years, the type of experience that children experience determines to a large extent which areas of their brain and which functions will develop best. The more a child or child has a particular experience — possibly reading, sports, music, canoeing, gardening or fishing — the stronger the brain zone associated with this activity, the more dense it becomes. As you assume, this is an adaptation process — the more time it takes to spend on these activities, the better the brain and body are prepared in these areas, thus preparing individuals for success in a given environment.

p48.original: 突触修剪 然而，遗传程序（以及头骨尺寸的物理限制）不允许大脑回路的这种巨量生长无限期地持续下去。到11岁时，那些没有被使用过的连接会被修剪掉，这个过程被称为“突触修剪”（synaptic pruning）。就像园丁通过修剪树木使最强壮的枝条得以更健康地生长，我们的大脑生来就会修剪掉最弱的和没用的连接，这样能量就会直接用来促进最强的和使用最频繁的连接的发展。通过这种方式，先天和后天互相作用发展出一个最适宜我们在环境中生存的神经系统。
p48.en: However, genetic processes (and physical limitations on skull size) do not allow this huge growth in brain circuits to continue indefinitely. By the age of 11, unused connections will be trimmed, a process known as synaptic cutting. Just as gardeners grow the strongest branches more healthy by cutting trees, our brains are born to trim the weakest and useless connections, so energy is used directly to promote the development of the strongest and most frequently used connections. In this way, the interaction between birth and nate develops a nervous system that is best suited for our survival in the environment.

p49.original: 这个修剪过程有多重要呢？最新的一项针对小鼠（它们的神经系统与人类的非常相似）的研究发现：当修剪过程出现问题时，突触就会变弱，而且突触的数量会变多，这会产生“神经噪声”并阻碍神经元之间的交流（Zhan et al.，2014）。这些小鼠会回避社会交往，热衷于重复性行为——这是孤独症谱系障碍（autism spectrum disorder，ASD）的两个典型症状。研究人员指出ASD的成因多种多样，错误的修剪过程可能会起到一定的作用，但它不是唯一的原因（Yong，2014）。尽管如此，这些新发现为寻找孤独症以及精神分裂症和强迫症的神经基础提供了非常有价值的线索。
p49.en: How important is this trim? A recent study of mice, whose nervous systems are very similar to those of humans, found that when a trimonic process occurs, synapses become weaker and the number of synapses increases, which creates “neurological noise” and hinders neurons communication (Zhan et al., 2014). These mice avoid social interaction and are keen to repeat sex - two typical symptoms of autism spectrum disorders (ASD). Researchers point out that ASD has a wide variety of causes and that an erroneous process of cutting may have played a role, but it is not the only reason (Yong, 2014). Nevertheless, these new discoveries provide valuable clues for the search for the neurological foundations of autism, schizophrenia and coercion.

p50.original: 敏感期 人生的早期阶段是大脑发展最快的时期。大脑改造自己以适应环境的能力，即可塑性（plasticity），在这个时期是最强的，并且自此之后不断下降。事实上，在某些领域，刺激必须出现在某些特定的“时机窗口”，否则这种能力可能就不能正常发展了（Lewis & Maurer，2005；Trainor，2005），这被称为发展的敏感期（sensitive period）。例如，进行语言加工的神经能否得到最佳发展取决于人生的最初几年是否接触过语言。某种语言能力最强的人往往是那些在婴儿期或者童年早期就接触过该语言的人。这个敏感期在4到5岁时就结束了，在此之后，语言发展就变得越来越困难了（Newport et al.，2001）。这些发现在口语和手语中都得到了印证：一项研究测试了出生时严重耳聋的成年人的美国手语（American Sign Language，ASL）水平，发现那些在青春期或成年后才开始学习美国手语的人从没有达到过那些在童年早期就开始学习的人的水平（Mayberry，1991；Singleton & Newport，2004）。与之类似，如果你曾在十几岁或成年之后学习一门新语言，你可能会发现这非常困难，远不如小时候学那么容易。很多其他能力也有敏感期，包括听觉和视觉，甚至是情绪反应：那些在生命早期缺乏和照料者积极互动的孩子，将不能发展出适应社会交往的正常能力（Knudsen，2004）。
p50.en: The early stages of life are the fastest-growing period of the brain. The ability of the brain to adapt itself to the environment can be plasticized, the strongest in this period, and has declined ever since. In fact, in some areas, incentives must appear in certain specific “time windows” or this capacity may not develop properly (Lewis & Maurer, 2005); Trainor, 2005, this is known as the sensitive period of development. For example, the optimal development of the nervous system for language processing depends on the first years of life having had contact with the language. Those who have the greatest linguistic ability are often those who come into contact with the language during infancy or early childhood. After this sensitive period ended between the ages of 4 and 5, language development became increasingly difficult (Newport et al., 2001). These findings were confirmed in both oral and sign language: a study tested American Sign Language (ASL) levels for adults who were severely deaf at birth, and found that those who began learning American Sign Language after puberty or adulthood had never reached the level of those who started learning early in childhood (Mayberry, 1991); Singapore & Newport, 2004. Similarly, if you have learned a new language in your teens or adulthood, you may find it very difficult to learn as easy as when you were a kid. Many other abilities also have sensitive periods, including hearing and visual, and even emotional responses: children who lack early in their lives and who interact actively with caregivers will not develop normal capacities to adjust to social interaction (Knudsen, 2004).

p52.original: 坐、爬、走——就像大脑的发育、青春期的爆发性成长，以及更年期的来临——所有这些都有其生物时间表。心理学家使用“成熟”（maturation）这个术语来描述遗传在这些随时间而来的生长发育过程中的作用。当生物体在合适的环境条件下成长时，他们的成熟将遵循一个可预测的模式。对于人类，成熟所带来的行为序列和模式可以参见图7-1。
p52.en: Sitting, climbing, walking — like brain development, the explosive growth of adolescence and the advent of menopause — all have biological timetables. Psychologists use the term “maturization” to describe the role of genetics in these growth and development processes over time. When organisms grow up under the right circumstances, their maturity will follow a predictable pattern. For human beings, the sequences and patterns of behaviour associated with maturity can be found in figure 7-1.

p53.original: 当然，我们还需要谨记环境的作用以及它与我们遗传特性之间的交互作用。虽然成熟确定了个体发展的大致时间框架意味着个体在生理上已经准备好进入一个新的阶段，但是环境可以使发展的实际时间提前或延后。著名生物学家爱德华·约翰逊（Wilson，1998，2004）把这一原则称为遗传约束（genetic leash）。例如，由于成熟的作用，绝大多数孩子学习走路都是遵循生理正常的人类个体的典型时间顺序模式。然而，由于遗传约束，那些从环境中得到额外帮助的孩子可以提前几个月学会走路。这一发现在几种非洲文化背景中都得到了证实，当地父母有抱着婴儿让他们用脚弹跳的习惯，这就加速了婴儿腿部肌肉和运动控制能力的发展（Gardiner et al.，1998）。相反的一个例子是，某些孤儿院的孩子与他人接触的机会很少，也很少离开他们的婴儿床，这些孩子学会走路的时间就明显比较晚（Dennis，1960）。在这两个例子中，来自环境的支持（或者支持不足）影响了成熟的速度——但是只限于在遗传约束的范围内。再多的弹跳练习也不能让婴儿在出生后的前几个月就学会走路。
p53.en: Of course, we also need to keep in mind the role of the environment and its interaction with our genetic characteristics. While maturity establishes a broad time frame for individual development, which means that individuals are physically ready to enter a new phase, the environment allows for the actual timing of development to be advanced or delayed. The well-known biologist Edward Johnson (Wilson, 1998, 2004) refers to this principle as genetic constraint. For example, due to the role of maturity, the vast majority of children learn to walk in the typical time-sequence pattern of biologically normal human individuals. However, owing to genetic constraints, children who receive additional help from the environment can learn to walk several months in advance. This finding has been confirmed in several African cultural contexts, where parents have the habit of carrying babies to allow them to jump with their feet, which accelerates the development of muscles and motor control in their legs (Gardiner et al., 1998). On the contrary, children in some orphanages have little access to others and rarely leave their cribs, and they learn to walk at a significantly later stage (Dennis, 1960). In both cases, support from the environment (or inadequate support) affects the pace of maturity - but is limited to genetic constraints. No more jumping exercises will allow the baby to learn to walk in the first few months of life.

p54.original: 在对其他人类发展模式的研究中，遗传约束这一概念也发挥着作用。它清晰地阐明了先天和后天之间必然存在的交互作用，这对于我们理解人类的发展方式和发展机制至关重要。我们将会在语言、认知发展、社会发展、道德发展和情绪发展等领域的研究中看到这种交互作用的例子，而且这种例子遍布人类生命周期的所有主要阶段。
p54.en: The concept of genetic restraints also plays a role in the study of other models of human development. It clearly articulates the inevitable interaction between the innate and the morrow, which is essential for our understanding of how humankind develops and of the mechanisms for its development. We will see examples of this interaction in research in the areas of language, cognitive development, social development, moral development and emotional development, and such examples span all the major stages of the human life cycle.

p57.original: 为了加深你对遗传约束在个体生命中的作用的理解，请选择图7-1中的一项运动功能，并对成年人和儿童能做什么事情以促进该能力发展提出一项建议。
p57.en: In order to deepen your understanding of the role of genetic restraints in individual life, please select a motor function in Figure 7-1 and make a recommendation on what adults and children can do to promote this capacity development.

p59.original: 2015年，一项对1 000多名儿童和青少年进行的里程碑式的研究，采用了一个令人震惊的标题——“贫穷使大脑萎缩”，这是该项研究的科学家宣布的。他们通过DNA检测和脑部扫描来寻找与家庭收入有关的神经差异。考虑到遗传、血统和父母教育都会影响认知水平，科学家在收集数据时首先把这些因素剔除出方程式。之后，他们控制了其他的可能因素，最终发现来自最低收入阶层的儿童的大脑质量比来自最高收入阶层儿童的大脑轻6%（Noble et al.，2015）。对于来自最贫困家庭的儿童，即使几千美元的收入差异也会造成大脑结构的明显差异，尤其是与语言、阅读、决策技能和学习相关的脑区。
p59.en: In 2015, a landmark study of more than 1,000 children and adolescents, with an alarming title — “Poverty causes brain atrophy”, was announced by scientists of the study. They search for neural differences related to family income through DNA testing and brain scans. Given that genetic, genetic and parental education affect cognitive levels, scientists first remove these factors from the equation when collecting data. They then controlled other possible factors and eventually found that children from the lowest income bracket had a brain quality 6 per cent lower than those from the highest income bracket (Noble et al., 2015). For children from the poorest families, even the thousands of dollars in income differentials can result in significant differences in brain structure, especially in the brain regions associated with language, reading, decision-making skills and learning.

p60.original: 图7-1 运动控制能力成熟时间表
p60.en: Figure 7-1 Timetable for the maturity of sports control capacity

p61.original: 虽然科学家和教育工作者早就知道来自弱势家庭的孩子在学校会遇到更多困难，但这是第一项将贫困的具体影响和其他因素区分开来的大规模研究。并且，由于基因的作用已经被排除在外，那么如营养、保健、学校环境和空气质量（均已被证实会影响大脑发育）等环境的影响，很可能就是造成这一神经缺陷的罪魁祸首。好在有证据表明干预措施可以扭转这种下降趋势。在墨西哥进行的一个项目给低收入家庭提供了现金补助，结果发现这对这些家庭的儿童的认知能力、语言发展和身体健康水平都有直接的积极影响（Fernald et al.，2008）。研究人员希望，这些最新发现可以推动学校健康午餐、优质课后项目和健康保健的开展。在该项研究结果发布之后，研究人员伊丽莎白·索维尔（Elizabeth Sowell）在采访中提到：“我们认识到儿童和青少年在环境中的经历将会影响大脑的连接方式。”（Gregoire，2015）“如果我们能够以某种方式丰富贫困儿童的环境，我们可能就可以改变这种趋势，在某种程度上使它趋于平衡。”
p61.en: While scientists and educators have long known that children from vulnerable families face additional difficulties in school, this is the first large-scale study to distinguish between the specific effects of poverty and other factors. Moreover, as the role of genes has been excluded, the effects of environments such as nutrition, health care, school environment and air quality (which have been proven to affect brain development) are likely to be responsible for this nervous deficiency. Fortunately, there is evidence that interventions can reverse this downward trend. A project in Mexico, which provided cash assistance to low-income families, found that this had a direct positive impact on the cognitive abilities, language development and physical health of children in those families (Fernald et al., 2008). Researchers hope that these latest findings will contribute to healthy school lunches, quality after-school projects and health care. Following the publication of the study, the interview with the researcher Elizabeth Sowell mentioned: “We recognize that the experiences of children and adolescents in the environment will influence how the brain connects. “If we can enrich the environment of poor children in one way or another, we may be able to change this trend and to some extent balance it.

p62.original: 营养在贫困与大脑发育之间扮演着关键作用。加拿大滑铁卢大学（University of Waterloo）的一项最新研究（2014）揭示出在3岁之前，与营养状况良好的儿童相比，营养状况不佳的儿童在认知技能和身体发育方面都存在缺陷。这些差异具有长期的经济影响：在这些孩子长大之后，他们获得的工资较低，会遭遇更多的健康问题，这不仅影响了他们自己的生活和产出，还会影响他们所生活的国家的国民经济。经济学家计算了政府投资于儿童营养的收益，发现在儿童营养上投入1美元会在儿童成人后获得166美元的收益。
p62.en: Nutrition plays a key role between poverty and brain development. A recent study by the University of Waterloo, Canada (2014) revealed that, before the age of three, children with poor nutritional status were deficient in cognitive skills and physical development compared to children with good nutritional status. These differences have long-term economic implications: when these children grow up, they receive lower wages and suffer additional health problems, which affect not only their own lives and outputs, but also the national economy of the countries in which they live. Economists calculated the benefits of government investment in child nutrition, and found that a $1 investment in child nutrition would yield $166 after children become adults.

p64.original: 婴儿要想通过先天和后天因素发展出更强的感觉和运动能力，他们就需要依赖照料者提供的必要刺激。我们尚未提及的一种典型的重要刺激是抚触。在19世纪上半叶——你可能很难相信——许多专家认为，婴儿寻求与照料者的身体接触仅仅是为了达成某种目的（获得食物或营养物质）的一种手段。“碗柜理论”（cupboard theory）的支持者认为，除了必要的营养物质，婴儿从身体接触中并没有获得其他好处。心理学家哈里·哈洛（Harry Harlow）和玛格丽特·哈洛（Margaret Harlow）不认可这一观点（Harlow，1965；Harlow & Harlow，1966）。他们用出生后就与母亲分离的幼猴检验了这一理论。哈洛夫妇将幼猴放到一个笼子里，那里有两个人造的代理妈妈。一个是挂着奶瓶且装有奶的简易铁丝妈妈——“碗柜”。另一个是绒布妈妈，它没有奶，但是柔软的绒布提供了丰富的刺激。结果呢？尽管铁丝妈妈提供了营养物质，但是幼猴只花了一点点时间跟铁丝妈妈待在一起，它们宁愿依偎在绒布妈妈旁。此外，当幼猴受到惊吓时，它们会紧靠在绒布妈妈身边来获得安慰。在探索新的场景时，它们也会以绒布妈妈为基地。通过这些观察，哈洛夫妇证实幼猴喜欢依附于能够提供接触安慰（contact comfort）的“妈妈”，通过身体接触，它们可以获得刺激和安慰。
p64.en: If babies are to develop greater sense and mobility through congenital and acquired factors, they need to rely on the necessary incentives from caregivers. A typical and important stimulus that we have not yet mentioned is touch. In the first half of the nineteenth century — and you may find it hard to believe — many experts believed that a baby sought physical contact with a caregiver only as a means of achieving a certain purpose (access to food or nutrients). Proponents of the "cupboard theory" believe that babies do not benefit from physical contact except for the necessary nutrients. This view was not endorsed by the psychologists Harry Harlow and Margaret Harlow (Harlow, 1965); Harlow & Harlow, 1966. They tested the theory with young monkeys who were separated from their mothers after birth. The Harlows put the young monkeys in a cage with two artificial surrogates. One is the mother of simple wire with a bottle and milk -- the "Cambers". The other is the fuzzy mother, who has no milk, but soft fuzzy cloth provides plenty of stimulus. What happened? Despite the nutrients provided by the wire mother, the young monkeys spend only a little time with the wire mother, who prefers to sit next to the fuzzy mother. Moreover, when young monkeys are frightened, they come close to their fuzzy mothers to be comforted. When exploring new scenes, they will also be based on their fuzzy mother. Through these observations, the Harlows confirmed that young monkeys prefer to be attached to “mothers” who can provide contact comfort, and that they can be stimulated and comforted by physical contact.

p65.original: 哈洛研究中的一只猴子，它依偎在能够提供接触安慰的人造绒布妈妈身上。在它的旁边，你可以看到铁丝妈妈，它能提供奶但不提供接触安慰。这是第一项揭示接触安慰重要性的研究。
p65.en: A monkey in Harold's study stings on a man-made mammy that can provide comfort. And next to it, you can see the barbed wire mother, who can provide milk but not contact comfort. This is the first study to reveal the importance of exposure and consolation.

p66.original: 人类婴儿也需要接触安慰。自哈洛夫妇的开创性研究以来，我们已经对人类的抚触需求有了很多了解。1986年，美国迈阿密大学（University of Miami）的发展心理学家蒂凡妮·菲尔德（Tiffany Field）首次针对按摩对早产儿的作用进行了实验研究。她发现，与没有接受按摩的婴儿相比，每天接受适度按摩的婴儿的体重增加得更快，消化道功能得到明显改善，社会反应更好（Field et al.，2010）。接受按摩的婴儿比没有接受按摩的婴儿平均提前6天出院，并且在1年之后，他们的智力和运动技能发展得更好——这表明早期按摩的好处会持续很长时间，远远超过了治疗范围。另一项研究发现，与没有接受按摩的婴儿相比，接受按摩的婴儿平时哭泣更少，睡眠更好，并且应激激素水平更低（Underdown et al.，2006）。
p66.en: Human babies also need to be exposed to comfort. Since the pioneering study by Mr. and Mrs. Harolds, we have learned a lot about the need for human touch. In 1986, Tiffany Field, a development psychologist at the University of Miami in the United States, carried out the first experimental study on the role of massage in premature births. She found that babies receiving moderate massages every day increased their weight faster, their digestive tract function improved markedly and their social response was better than those who did not receive massages (Field et al., 2010). The children who receive massages are discharged on average six days ahead of those who do not, and after one year their intellectual and motor skills are better developed — indicating that the benefits of early massages will last for a long time, well beyond the scope of treatment. Another study found that a massaged baby cries less regularly, sleeps better and has lower levels of hormones than a baby without a massage (Underdown et al., 2006).

p67.original: 按摩为什么会有这么多显而易见的好处？对此，你的看法是什么？
p67.en: Why does a massage have so many obvious advantages? What do you think about that?

p68.original: 虽然背后的机制尚未完全清楚，但现有研究已有一些初步的发现。最近的一项研究采集了被试的血样后，给他们15分钟的按摩或者让他们安静地休息15分钟。之后，研究人员再一次采集了被试的血样，结果显示：和初始血样相比，按摩组被试的应激激素水平较低而催产素（oxytocin）水平较高（Morhenn et al.，2012）。这些发现和另一些研究的结果是一致的，这些研究都表明，抚触会降低心率，并有助于因威胁和危险激发的应激反应系统更快地恢复正常水平。与这些强调抚触的好处的研究结果相吻合的是，另一些研究发现受到虐待或忽视的儿童会有一些负面表现（Glaser，2003）。显然，与有爱心的成年人的亲密互动关系是儿童迈向身体发育健康和社会交往正常的第一步（Blum，2002；Sapolsky，2002）。
p68.en: While the mechanism behind it is not yet fully clear, some preliminary findings have been made in existing studies. A recent study took samples of the blood tested and gave them 15 minutes of massage or 15 minutes of rest in peace. Later, the researchers took another sample of the blood tested, showing that the oxytocin level of the oxytocin was lower than the initial blood sample (Morehenn et al., 2012). These findings are consistent with the results of other studies, which show that tasting reduces heart rate and contributes to a faster return to normal levels of stress systems motivated by threats and hazards. In line with these studies, which emphasize the benefits of touch, other studies have found some negative manifestations of child abuse or neglect (Glaser, 2003). Clearly, intimate interaction with caring adults is the first step towards healthy physical development and normal social interaction for children (Blum, 2002); Sapolsky, 2002.

p70.original: 心理学家将儿童和父母之间建立的亲密情感联系称为依恋（attachment）。这种关系至关重要，因为它为一个人一生中随后的其他亲密关系奠定了基础（Cassidy & Shaver，2008）。
p70.en: Psychologists refer to the intimate emotional connection between the child and the parents as attachment. This relationship is essential because it provides the basis for other relationships of intimacy that follow a person's life (Cassidy & Shaver, 2008).

p71.original: 依恋并不局限于人类婴儿和亲生父母之间的联系，它似乎是许多物种都拥有的一种本能。依恋的一个著名例子就是印刻（imprinting），出生后见到的第一个移动的物体对某些物种（尤其是鸟类）的幼崽有着强烈的吸引力。由一只母鸭孵化出来的小鸡会对它的养母产生依恋——虽然它自己是小鸡而不是小鸭子。当鸭妈妈和小鸭子们去游泳时，这只被印刻的小鸡甚至会跟着它的养母走到水边。汉斯·克里斯蒂安·安徒生（Hans Christian Andersen）的故事《丑小鸭》就描述了这一科学概念。因此，印刻倾向是天生的，虽然环境决定了印刻会采用何种形式。
p71.en: A attachment is not limited to the link between human babies and biological parents, but appears to be an instinct that many species possess. A well-known example of attachment is imprinting, where the first moving object seen after birth has a strong appeal to the cubs of certain species, especially birds. A chick hatched by a female duck would become attached to its adoptive mother — although it was a chick rather than a duck. When the duck mother and the ducklings go swimming, the stamped chick will even follow her adoptive mother to the water. The story of Hans Christian Andersen, The Ugly Duck, describes this scientific concept. As a result, the tendency to mark is natural, although the environment determines the form that it takes.

p72.original: 对人类的接触安慰的研究为依恋的生理需求提供了早期证据。在哈洛夫妇的幼猴实验的基础上，心理学家约翰·鲍比（John Bowlby）认为，人类的依恋也是天生的，在出生后的头几周就开始了，它是婴儿的一种生存策略。从进化视角来看，我们很容易理解，那些待在照料者身边的婴儿遇到危险的概率较小。例如，一项研究发现：当妈妈离开房间时，2～4个月的婴儿的皮肤温度会降低，这是情感上痛苦的一种信号（Mizukami et al.，1990）。对于这些小孩，当一个陌生人来替代其妈妈时，他们的皮肤温度会下降得更多。但是，当妈妈待在房间里——即使陌生人也在，他们的皮肤温度也会保持稳定。显然，在他们可以使用爬或者走来表达他们的依恋之前，几个月大的孩子已经把他们的照料者当成了“避风港”（Bee，1994）。
p72.en: Studies of human contact comfort provide early evidence of the biological need for attachment. On the basis of a young monkey experiment by Mr. and Mrs. Harlow, the psychologist John Bowlby believed that human attachment was also natural and had begun in the first weeks of life as a survival strategy for infants. From an evolutionary perspective, it is easy to understand that babies who are around caregivers are less likely to be at risk. For example, a study found that when a mother leaves the room, the skin temperature of a child of two to four months is reduced, a sign of emotional distress (Mizukami et al., 1990). For these children, when a stranger replaces his mother, their skin temperature drops even more. But when moms stay in the room - even strangers, their skin temperatures remain stable. It is clear that, before they could use climbing or walking to express their attachment, older children have used their caregivers as “safe havens” (Bee, 1994).

p73.original: 依恋类型 你是否曾经注意到不同孩子的依恋程度是不一样的？对于有些孩子来说，只要他们的主要照料者在场，他们就可以自在地与陌生人相处，但是另一些孩子比较粘人，会感到害怕，还有一些孩子似乎根本不在乎谁在他们身边。发展心理学家玛丽·安斯沃斯（Mary Ainsworth）不仅注意到了这些行为模式，而且致力于研究人类的不同依恋类型。她开发的一种非常有创意的实验程序被称为“陌生情境”（Strange Situation），它是至今仍在使用的测试依恋的标准测验。
p73.en: Type of attachment. Have you ever noticed that different children have different levels of attachment? For some children, they can live with strangers as long as their primary caregivers are present, but others are more sticky and scared, and others seem to care nothing about who is around them. Mary Ainsworth, a development psychologist, not only notes these patterns of behaviour, but also works to study different types of human attachment. A very innovative experiment she has developed, known as Strarge Situation, is a standard test for the testing of attachment that is still in use.

p74.original: 这个巧妙的测验程序是怎样的呢？陌生情境测验让儿童和他们的主要照料者进行一系列的互动——有时候在一起，有时候分开，有时候是和陌生人在一起。然后，研究人员观察儿童在这些不同情境中的反应，尤其注意当照料者从短暂离开到返回时儿童的行为反应（Ainsworth，1989；Lamb，1999）。在不同的文化中采用这种方法进行研究之后，安斯沃斯发现儿童的反应可以分为两类：安全型依恋（secure attachment）和不安全型依恋（insecure attachment）。安全型依恋的孩子和照料者在一起时是比较放松的，他们可以接受甚至有点喜欢跟陌生人在一起或者做一些新鲜的事情。当和照料者分开时，他们会感到不安——对于一个6～20个月大的孩子来说，这是一种正常反应，被称为分离焦虑（separation anxiety）——但是当照料者回来时，他们很快就能镇定下来并继续进行自己的活动。他们将照料者视为自己探索世界的“安全基地”，并相信照料者会在他们有需要时给予他们帮助。
p74.en: What's this clever test program like? Strange situation tests allow children and their primary caregivers to interact in a series of ways — sometimes together, sometimes separately, sometimes with strangers. The researchers then observe the children's reactions in these uncompassionate situations, paying particular attention to the child's behavioural responses when the caregiver leaves briefly and returns (Ainsworth, 1989); Lamb, 1999. Following this approach in research in different cultures, Answorth found that children's responses can be divided into two categories: safe attachment and unsafe attachment. Safely attached children and caregivers are more relaxed when they are together, and they can accept even a little like being with strangers or doing something new. When separated from caregivers, they are disturbed — a normal response for a 6 to 20-month-old child, known as separation anxiety — but when caregivers return, they can quickly calm down and continue their activities. They see caregivers as a “safe base” for themselves to explore the world and trust that caregivers will help them when they need them.

p75.original: 不安全型依恋的儿童可以分成两类：焦虑-矛盾型和回避型。和安全型儿童一样，这两类儿童也会在照料者离开房间时感到不安，但是他们的不同之处在于当照料者回来时他们的反应。焦虑-矛盾型依恋（anxious-ambivalent）儿童想要和照料者待在一起，但是当照料者回来时他们变得很难安抚，尽管照料者试图给予他们安慰，但他们仍然感到不安。当陌生人靠近的时候，他们会感到害怕并紧紧地靠着照料者，并且他们也很难自在地探索新环境。相反，回避型依恋（avodiant）的孩子拒绝与返回来的照料者接触，经常逃避眼神接触并拒绝与照料者互动。总体来说，大约有65%的美国儿童是安全型依恋，20%的儿童是回避型，15%的儿童是焦虑-矛盾型（Berk，2007）。
p75.en: Children who are unsafe and attached to relationships can be divided into two categories: anxiety-continuous and evasive. As with safe children, these two groups of children are disturbed when caregivers leave their rooms, but their differences are due to their reaction when caregivers return. Children in anxiety-continuous attachments want to be with caregivers, but when caregivers come back they become difficult to comfort, and they remain disturbed despite their attempts to comfort them. When strangers come closer, they are afraid and close to caregivers, and it is difficult for them to explore new environments. On the contrary, children of evasive attachments refuse contact with returning caregivers, often avoid eye contact and refuse to interact with caregivers. Overall, about 65 per cent of United States children are safe dependents, 20 per cent are evasive and 15 per cent are anxiety-continuing (Berk, 2007).

p76.original: 在过去的十年中，依恋成为非常热门的研究主题，因为大量研究表明在婴儿期形成的模式会影响儿童和成年人的各种行为，包括攻击性、友谊、工作满意度、人际关系选择和亲密关系经历（Berk，2004；Gomez & McLaren，2007）。
p76.en: Over the past decade, attachment has become a very popular research theme, as a large body of research has shown that the formation of patterns in infancy can affect the behaviour of children and adults, including aggressiveness, friendship, job satisfaction, interpersonal choice and intimate relationships (Berk, 2004); Gomez & McLaren, 2007.

p77.original: 但是，是什么导致儿童发展出某种特定的依恋类型？你对此如何看？
p77.en: But what leads children to develop a particular type of attachment? What do you think of that?

p78.original: 很多年来，教养方式被认为是主要原因：具体来说，心理学家认为敏感又有责任感的父母会养育出安全型依恋的儿童，而前后不一致的养育方式会养出焦虑-矛盾型儿童，忽略的养育方式会导致回避型依恋。环境也起到了一定的作用：与在孤儿院长大的孤儿相比，罗马尼亚的孤儿在两周岁前生活在一个寄养家庭中，他们更有可能发展出安全型依恋模式（Smyke et al.，2010）。因此，这样看来依恋类型的发展也有一个敏感期。
p78.en: For many years, upbringing has been considered the main cause: specifically, psychologists believe that sensitive and responsible parents can raise safe-type children, while inconsistent parenting can give rise to anxiety-controversial children, and neglected parenting can lead to evasive-type attachments. The environment also plays a role: orphans in Romania live in a foster home before the age of two years and are more likely to develop a safe relationship model (Smyke et al., 2010). There is therefore also a sensitive period for the development of the type of attachment that appears to be involved.

p79.original: 然而，如今大多数研究人员认为在依恋类型的发展中先天和后天因素是共同起作用的。例如，婴儿的气质在很大程度上是由基因决定的，它会影响婴儿是否会积极回应他人。既然如此，下面这项研究结果也就不足为奇了，该研究发现那些出生几天就焦虑不安的婴儿更有可能在1年之后发展为焦虑-矛盾型依恋类型（Miyake，1993）。这看起来很合理，因为相对于乖宝宝，大多数父母更难始终如一地“读取”喜怒无常的宝宝发出的信号，这样，婴儿的气质和父母的教养方式之间就产生了交互作用。
p79.en: However, most researchers today believe that the factors of birth and genre in the development of attachment-types work together. For example, the quality of the baby is largely genetic and it affects whether the baby responds positively to others. It is not surprising, then, that the following study found that babies born in a few days of anxiety are more likely to develop into anxiety-controversial types of attachment after one year (Miyake, 1993). This seems reasonable, because it is more difficult for most parents to “read” consistently the signals sent by the grumpy babies, as opposed to the good ones, so that there is a interaction between the quality of the babies and the way the parents are raised.

p80.original: 文化和依恋 在判断哪种依恋类型是“最佳”依恋类型之前，先考虑一下文化的重要影响。你是否如大多数美国人一样认为安全型依恋是最好的？与此相反，德国家庭偏好回避型依恋，因为它会提升儿童的自力更生能力；而日本父母很少让他们的孩子一个人待着，这就使得日本的孩子更依赖父母，也更可能成为焦虑-矛盾型依恋类型（Grossman et al.，1985；Miyake et al.，1985）。因此，像很多品质一样，对于什么是“最佳”类型的判断在很大程度上取决于该文化中的主流价值观。
p80.en: Culture and attachment, before deciding which type of attachment is the “best” type of attachment, consider the important implications of culture. Do you, like most Americans, think safe attachments are the best? In contrast, German families prefer evasive attachments, as it enhances children's self-reliance; Japanese parents rarely leave their children alone, which makes them more dependent on their parents and more likely to be an anxiety-continuous type of attachment (Grossman et al., 1985); Miyake et al., 1985. Thus, as with many qualities, the determination of what constitutes the “best” type depends to a large extent on the prevailing values in the culture.

p81.original: 依恋的长期影响 不只是孩子会产生依恋。当孩子长大成人后，他们的依恋对象不再是他们的主要照料者：他们会持续扩大他们的依恋对象，包括其他家庭成员、朋友、老师、同事以及他们社会关系中的其他人。然而，证据显示最初的依恋关系会成为后续重要关系的内在工作模型。换句话说，不管孩子最初从与照料者之间关系中学会了对依恋关系有什么样的期待，这种期待都将成为他们看待和理解以后关系的滤镜。安全型依恋的孩子可能会适应良好并且善于与他人互动，焦虑-矛盾型依恋的孩子经常会变成疑神疑鬼的人，回避型依恋的孩子很少会与他人建立亲密的情感关系。因此，依恋类型会成为成年期亲密关系的预测指标。
p81.en: The long-term effects of attachment are not just that children have attachments. When children grow up, their attachment ceases to be their primary caregiver: they continue to expand their attachment to other family members, friends, teachers, colleagues and others in their social relations. However, evidence suggests that initial attachments can become an intrinsic working model for subsequent important relationships. In other words, whatever expectations children may have of attachment in their relationship with caregivers at first, this expectation will be a filter for their perception and understanding of subsequent relationships. Safe-type attachments can be well adapted and interacting with others, anxiety-controversial attachments often become suspicious, and avoiding attachments rarely establish intimate emotional relationships with others. As a result, the type of attachment becomes the predictive indicator of adult intimacy.

p82.original: 我们应该强调的是，尽管依恋的作用很强大，但在婴儿期和儿童期缺乏健康依恋的个体并不一定会成为生活中的失败者。虽然依恋问题是后续社会关系问题的很好的预测指标，但是很多人成功克服了依恋困难（Kagan，1996，1998）。在儿童期甚至是成年期的健康关系都可以“重置”这个工作模型。谨记这些告诫，我们现在邀请你填写下面的自测问卷，看看你的依恋类型是什么。
p82.en: We should stress that, despite the powerful role of attachment, individuals who lack healthy attachments during infancy and childhood do not necessarily become losers in life. Although attachment is a good predictor of the follow-up of social relations, many have succeeded in overcoming attachment difficulties (Kagan, 1996, 1998). Health relationships can be “replaced” in childhood and even adulthood. With these caveats in mind, we now invite you to fill out the self-measurement questionnaire below and see what type of attachment you have.

p83.original: 试一试 你的依恋类型是什么
p83.en: Try it. What's your type of attachment?

p84.original: 在下面三种描述中你觉得哪一种与自己最相符（改编自Shaver & Hazan，1994）？
p84.en: Which of the following three descriptions do you think is best suited to yourself (adapted from Shaver & Hazan, 1994)?

p85.original: 1. 与他人亲近会让我觉得有些不自在；我发现自己很难完全信任他人，也很难依赖他人。当与别人太过亲密时我会感到紧张，我的爱人经常会希望我们的关系能够更加亲密，而我对那种程度的亲密感到不舒服。
p85.en: 1. I find myself somewhat uncomfortable by being close to others; I find it hard to trust and depend on others. I get nervous when I'm too close to others, and my lovers often want our relationship to be closer, and I feel uncomfortable with that level of intimacy.

p86.original: 2. 我发现他人不愿意与我太过亲密。我经常担心我的爱人并不是真的爱我或者不想和我在一起，我的这种想法有时候会把他人吓跑。
p86.en: 2. I find others unwilling to be too close to me. I often worry that my lover does not really love me or do not want to be with me, and that sometimes my thoughts scare people away.

p87.original: 3. 我发现我能很容易地亲近他人，也能很自在地依赖他们。我很少担心会被他人抛弃或者担心他人与我太过亲近。
p87.en: 3. I find it easy for me to reach out to others and to rely on them quite comfortably. I rarely fear being abandoned or being too close to me.

p89.original: 我们知道你很容易就能猜到哪个选项是“最好的”——至少从美国人的视角看是最好的。尽管如此，请思考一下其他选项，这将有助于你更好地理解依恋类型——也许也能更好地理解你自己。下面是我们的解释。
p89.en: We know that you can easily guess which option is “best” — at least from an American perspective. Nevertheless, think about other options that will help you to better understand the type of attachment — and perhaps you can also better understand yourself. Here's our explanation.

p90.original: 1. 如果你选择第一种陈述，那么你认可的态度反映的是一种回避的、不安全的依恋。在调查成年人依恋类型的研究中，这种类型的人接近25%（Hazan & Shaver，1990）。
p90.en: 1. If you choose the first statement, then your acceptance reflects an evasive and insecure attachment. In studies investigating adult attachment patterns, this category of persons is close to 25 per cent (Hazan & Shaver, 1990).

p91.original: 2. 第二种陈述反映的是一种焦虑-矛盾的、不安全的依恋类型，研究中大约有20%的人属于这种类型。
p91.en: 2. The second statement reflects an anxiety-ambivalent, unsafe type of attachment, which is the category of approximately 20 per cent of the population studied.

p92.original: 3. 第三种陈述反映的是一种安全的依恋类型，这是最常见的类型，占受访者的55%（Shaver & Hazan，1994）。
p92.en: 3. The third statement reflects a type of security attachment, the most common type, accounting for 55 per cent of respondents (Shaver & Hazan, 1994).

p94.original: 通过访谈、观察和问卷，心理学家已经确定了成年期依恋类型的几个相关因素（Ainsworth，1989；Collins & Read，1990；Hazan & Shaver，1990；Kirkpatrick & Shaver，1992；Shaver & Hazan，1993，1994；Simpson，1990）。
p94.en: Through interviews, observations and questionnaires, psychologists have identified several factors relevant to the type of adult attachment (Answorth, 1989); Collins & Read, 1990; Hazan & Shaver, 1990; Kirkpatrick & Shaver, 1992; Shaver & Hazan, 1993, 1994; Simpson, 1990.

p95.original: • 安全型的人具有更加积极的自我概念，并且相信绝大多数人的本性都是好的，都是善意的。他们认为自己的人际关系是可以信赖的，并对它感到满意。
p95.en: • Security-type people have a more active concept of self-determination and believe that the vast majority of people are good in nature and good in heart. They believe that their interpersonal relations can be trusted and are satisfied with it.

p96.original: • 安全型的人对他们的工作保障、同事、收入和工作内容都感到满意。他们认为人际关系比工作更加重要，并且从与他人的联系中获得最大的愉悦感。
p96.en: • Security-type persons are satisfied with their job security, colleagues, income and work content. They see interpersonal relationships as more important than work and gain the greatest pleasure from their contacts with others.

p97.original: • 不安全的、焦虑-矛盾型的人报告说自己有极端情绪和嫉妒心理。他们觉得自己怀才不遇，缺乏安全感，并且觉得自己不可能在职业上有好的发展。和其他依恋类型的个体相比，他们收入较低；他们工作更多的是为了获得赏识和认可，而不是为了经济收益。他们幻想成功，但是却在得到表扬后又常常懈怠。
p97.en: • Unsafe, anxiety-controversial people report extreme emotions and jealousy. They feel that they are not pregnant, that they lack security and that they cannot develop in a good career. They earn less than other attachment-type individuals; They work more for recognition and recognition than for economic gain. They fantasize about success, but they are often remiss when they are praised.

p98.original: • 回避型的人害怕亲密关系并且总觉得他们的人际关系最终会走向失败。他们认为工作比人际关系更加重要，通常他们喜欢自己的工作以及工作带来的保障。他们热衷于工作，但是（不用感到惊讶）对他们的同事并不满意。
p98.en: • The avoiding-type people fear intimacy and always feel that their human relationships will end up failing. They see work as more important than interpersonal relationships, and they usually like their work and the security it offers. They are keen to work, but (do not be surprised) they are not satisfied with their colleagues.

p99.original: • 安全型的人倾向于选择安全型的人作为自己的伙伴。分手后，回避型的人会声称关系破裂不会对自己造成困扰，不过这可能是一种自我防御，他们的烦恼会以另一种形式表现出来（如躯体症状）。
p99.en: • Secure people tend to choose safe people as partners. After a break-up, the evasive person would claim that the break-up of the relationship would not bother him or herself, although it might be a self-defence, and his or her distress would manifest itself in another form (e.g., physical symptoms).

p100.original: 7.3.6 社会心理发展：信任对不信任

p101.original: 大量的依恋研究结果与一个毕生发展理论的第一个阶段非常吻合。埃里克·埃里克森（Erik Erikson，1902—1994）是一位杰出的精神分析学家。他认为，随着人生经历的增加，我们会在无意识层面形成关于我们自己和他人关系的基本信念。我们在人际关系中做出的选择受到这些基本信念的影响，而这又影响着我们的发展。不仅如此，埃里克森还认为每一个基本信念都来自我们人生发展中的一个关键时期的一次危机（这次危机可能会被成功解决，也可能一直没有被解决）。因此，他把他自己的发展理论中的8个社会心理发展阶段（psychosocial stage）分别标识为在两个对立信念间所做的选择，例如，信任对不信任，这是我们人生中遇到的第一个发展问题（见表7-1）。
p101.en: A great deal of attachment to the findings of research is very much in line with the first phase of a life-long development theory. Erik Erikson, 1902-1994, is an outstanding psychoanalyst. He believes that, with the increase in life experience, we will form a basic belief at the unconscious level about our relationship with others. The choices we make in human relations are influenced by these fundamental beliefs, which in turn affect our development. Moreover, Eriksson believes that every fundamental conviction stems from a crisis (which may or may not have been resolved) at a critical time in the development of our lives. He therefore identified the eight psycho-social stages of his own development theory (psychosocial stage) as the choice between two opposing beliefs, for example, trust and mistrust, the first development issue in our lives (see table 7-1).

p102.original: 埃里克森的理论提出，在出生后的头18个月，婴儿面临的主要发展任务是建立对这个世界的信任（trust）。正如我们所知，安全型依恋的婴儿将世界视为一个有趣的地方，充满了有待他们探索的新鲜体验。这些婴儿将主要照料者看作“安全基地”，从这里开始探索世界，带着这份安全感，他们将成长为能够适应新环境的、具有冒险精神和坚韧品质的儿童（和成年人），这些品质将帮助他们度过一生。在这一成长阶段，儿童如果形成了不安全型依恋，他们在随后的发展中将难以应对挑战，因为缺乏信任将成为他和社会之间的阻碍。简言之，没有对他人建立基本信任感的婴儿，将难以形成和维持令人满意的人际关系。这样，无意识的信任感会促使个体去选择信任他人，而对他人持不信任这一基本信念的个体将会选择怀疑他人。
p102.en: Eriksen's theory suggests that the main development challenge for infants in the first 18 months of life is to build trust in the world (trust). As we know, safe-type dependent babies see the world as an interesting place, filled with fresh experiences to be explored by them. These babies look at their primary caregivers as “safe bases” from which to explore the world, with the sense of security that they will grow into risk-taking and resilient children (and adults) able to adapt to the new environment, which will help them live their lives. At this stage of development, children will have difficulty in coping with the challenge if they develop unsafe attachments, as lack of trust will be an obstacle between themselves and society. In short, it will be difficult for infants who do not build a basic sense of trust in others to develop and maintain satisfactory interpersonal relationships. In this way, the unconscious sense of trust prompts individuals to choose to trust others, and individuals who have the fundamental belief that they do not trust others will choose to doubt others.

p103.original: 尽管埃里克森的理论受到一些批评，但这些批评主要是围绕着是否对每一个人来说8个阶段的顺序都是一样的，或者（有部分可能在文化规范的基础上）对不同的人来说8个阶段是否可以发生在人生不同的时间点上。批评者同样也注意到，埃里克森的工作主要是基于他自己的临床观察，而不是严谨的科学方法。然而，值得注意的是，他的很多观察发现后来都得到了一些方法学上很严密的研究的支持。并且，他的理论是第一个涵盖了整个生命周期的人类发展理论，先前的理论都只对生命的前12～17年感兴趣，而由此产生的一种错误的观念是一旦你度过了青春期，你就完成了你的成长，不会再有发展！出于这些原因，直到今天，埃里克森的理论在人类发展研究中仍占据重要地位。
p103.en: Although Eriksen's theory has been criticized, these criticisms revolve around whether the order of the eight stages is the same for everyone or (some of them may be based on cultural norms) whether the eight stages can take place at different points in life. Critics similarly noted that Eriksson's work was based mainly on his own clinical observations rather than on a rigorous scientific approach. It is noteworthy, however, that many of his observations were subsequently supported by methodologically rigorous research. Moreover, his theory was the first one of human development that covered the entire life cycle, and the previous theory was only interested in the first 12 to 17 years of life, and the resulting misconception was that once you had gone through puberty, you would have completed your growth and no further development! For these reasons, to date, Eriksson's theory has continued to occupy a prominent place in human development research.

p104.original: 表7-1 埃里克森的社会心理发展阶段

p105.original: 心理学很有用 不只是娱乐和游戏：儿童的“玩”在人生成功中的作用
p105.en: Psychology is useful, not just for entertainment and play: the role of play for children in the success of life.

p106.original: 现在，我们已经认识到先天和后天因素都会对我们一生的表现产生影响。让我们通过考察一个心理特质来阐释这种交互作用，这个心理特质就是自我控制（self-control），它对人生成功至关重要。这种能力会抑制我们的冲动，让我们做出有效的选择，因此经常要求我们延迟即时满足以追求更长期的成功。越来越多的研究发现，低自我控制是青少年不良行为和犯罪行为的有力预测指标，而高自我控制与一系列积极结果有关——包括更幸福的人际关系、更优异的成绩、更高的自尊水平、安全型依恋以及更少酗酒（Tangney et al.，2004）。即使把智力和社会阶层（另外两个预测成功的有力指标）的作用考虑进来，自我控制仍然是这些重要的人生表现的最强有力的预测指标（Moffitt et al.，2011）。因此，显而易见，自我控制很重要——那么我们如何获得自我控制能力呢？
p106.en: Now, we have realized that congenital and acquired factors have an impact on our performance throughout our lives. Let us interpret this interaction by examining a psychological trait, self-control, which is essential to the success of life. This ability inhibits our impulse to make effective choices, and therefore often requires us to delay immediate satisfaction in pursuit of longer-term success. A growing number of studies have found that low self-control is a powerful predictive indicator of youth misconduct and criminality, and that high self-control is associated with a range of positive outcomes — including better interpersonal relations, better performance, higher levels of self-esteem, safe attachments and less alcohol abuse (Tangney et al., 2004). Even taking into account the role of the intellectual and social classes (the other two powerful indicators of forecast success), self-control remains the most powerful predictive indicator of these important human performances (Moffitt et al., 2011). It is therefore clear that self-control is important — how can we acquire self-control?

p107.original: 先天——或者我们的遗传基因——设定了我们管理情绪和控制冲动的基线能力水平。双生子研究为此提供了支持证据，例如，研究发现，同卵双胞胎在冲动性方面的相似性比异卵双胞胎更大（Vernon et al.，2008）。然而，遗传对这一特质的贡献只能解释40%的变异——这就为环境的作用留出了足够的空间。
p107.en: Innate — or our genetic genes — set the baseline level of our ability to manage emotions and control impulses. The twin-child study provides supporting evidence for this, for example, finding that identical twins are more similar in impulse than inter-ovarian twins (Vernon et al., 2008). However, the contribution of genetics to this quality can only explain 40 per cent of the variation — leaving enough room for the role of the environment.

p108.original: 依据我们对大脑发育和可塑性的了解，显而易见的是，我们越早开始培养自我控制，我们的自我控制能力就会发展得越好。父母可以教会孩子用一系列简单的方法管理冲动。例如，在外出之前收拾他们的玩具，在看电视之前完成家庭作业，或者在吃甜品之前吃完蔬菜。清晰、一致的规则可以帮助儿童学习管理他们的世界，并为实现目标提供指导。在学校里，进行某些活动的老师会在脖子上套一张双面的卡片。当孩子们表现好的时候老师就展示卡片绿色的那一面，当某个孩子不遵守纪律时老师就把卡片翻转过来，出示红色的一面来提醒他。通过这种方式，孩子们获得了及时又适宜的反馈，这些反馈会帮助他们学会管理情绪并做出积极的选择——从而通过环境的影响来扩展冲动控制的“遗传约束”。
p108.en: Based on our knowledge of brain development and plasticity, it is clear that the sooner we begin to develop self-control, the better our self-control capabilities will develop. Parents can teach their children to manage their impulses in a series of simple ways. For example, they pack their toys before going out, finish homework before watching television, or finish vegetables before eating dessert. Clear and consistent rules can help children learn to manage their world and guide the achievement of goals. In schools, teachers who perform certain activities wear a double-sided card around their necks. When the children behave well, the teacher shows the green side of the card, and when a child fails to comply with discipline, the teacher flips the card and shows the red side to remind him. In this way, children receive timely and appropriate feedback that helps them to learn to manage emotions and make positive choices - thus extending “genetic constraints” of impulse control through environmental impacts.

p109.original: 然而，规则和结构的作用也可能被夸大了。在过去几十年里，越来越多的儿童心理学家表达了对儿童期游戏方式变化的关注（Berk，2002）。和从前的孩子相比，今天的孩子把更多的游戏时间放在受指导的结构化的游戏上，如社团运动，而富有想象力的“过家家”式的假扮游戏变得更少了。为什么这一点很重要？与结构化游戏相比，即兴游戏需要儿童进行更多的思考、计划、创造力和自我管理——正是这些技能帮助儿童发展他们的执行功能（executive function），或者开发与目标设定和自我调节相关的大脑前额皮层。研究表明，儿童与同伴进行的想象游戏越多，他们的执行功能就会发展得越早，这使得他们能更好地与同伴合作，更愿意参与到指定任务中，有更强的责任感，并且会有更好的社交技能（Elias & Berk，2002）。
p109.en: However, the role of rules and structures may also be exaggerated. Over the past few decades, an increasing number of child psychologists have expressed concern about changes in the way children play (Berk, 2002). Today's children spend more time on structured games, such as community sports, than their former ones, while imaginative “pass home”-style games become less. Why is this important? As opposed to structured games, improvisation requires more reflection, planning, creativity and self-management by children — the same skills that help children develop their executive function, or the front cortex of the brain associated with targeting and self-regulation. Research shows that the more children and their peers engage in imaginary games, the sooner their performance functions develop, which makes them better able to work with their peers, more willing to participate in assigned tasks, more responsible and better social skills (Elias & Berk, 2002).

p110.original: 此外，富有想象力的游戏有助于拓展儿童的词汇量。例如，扮演医生的年幼孩子，会使用一些他们平常不用的更正式的词，如“注射”或者“体温计”。玩“机场”游戏的学龄前儿童告诉另一个“乘客”，她的水杯超过了88毫升的液体限额（Bartlett，2011）。心理学家劳拉·伯克（Laura Berk）指出，孩子们为了自我调节和制定游戏规则，需要专注于“自言自语”，告诉自己在计划和执行游戏的每一个阶段应该怎么做。这样，他们不仅提高了语言技能，还提升了认知灵活性和自我控制。
p110.en: In addition, imaginative games help to expand the vocabulary of children. For example, young children who act as doctors use more formal terms they do not normally use, such as “injection” or “body thermometer”. Pre-school children playing the “airport” game told another “passenger” that her glass exceeded the liquid limit of 88 ml (Bartlett, 2011). Laura Berk, a psychologist, pointed out that in order to regulate themselves and set the rules of the game, children needed to focus on “self-talking” and tell themselves what to do at every stage of planning and implementing the game. In this way, they have not only improved their language skills, but also their cognitive flexibility and self-control.

p111.original: 这些孩子假装正在一起坐飞机，这会发展他们的执行功能，拓展他们的词汇量，并提升他们的交流能力。
p111.en: These children pretend to be flying together, which will develop their executive functions, expand their vocabulary and enhance their communication capabilities.

p112.original: 一项研究强有力地揭示了游戏类型演变的另一个后果。这项重复性研究比较了21世纪的儿童和20世纪40年代的儿童。除了其他事情之外，3岁、5岁和7岁的儿童还被要求静止站立一段时间。70年前，5岁儿童可以静止站立3分钟，7岁儿童可以需要站多久就多久。然而，在目前这项研究中，5岁儿童根本不能静止站立，7岁儿童可以听从指示站立3分钟——而这是20世纪40年代的研究中5岁儿童的水平（Spiegel，2008）。
p112.en: One study strongly reveals another consequence of the evolution of the type of game. This repetitive study compares the children of the twenty-first century with those of the 1940s. Among other things, children aged 3, 5 and 7 were required to stand still for a while. Seventy years ago, five-year-olds could stand still for three minutes and seven-year-olds could stand for as long as they needed. However, in the present study, children aged 5 are not able to stand still at all, and children aged 7 can stand on instructions for three minutes — this is the level of children aged 5 in the study of the 1940s (Spiegel, 2008).

p113.original: 虽然现代化生活确实给儿童带来了各种好处，但显然并没能增强他们的自我控制能力。“天性”不能解释这种变化，因为进化不可能在这么短的时间内发生。因此，既然研究表明自我控制和很多领域的成功都存在联系，那么父母和老师应更努力地去创造环境来帮助儿童发展这种重要的能力。
p113.en: While modern life does bring benefits to children, it is clear that it has not been possible to enhance their self-control. “Nature” does not explain this change, as evolution cannot take place in such a short time. Therefore, since studies have shown that there are links between self-control and success in many areas, parents and teachers should make greater efforts to create an environment that will help children develop this important capacity.
